theorems.name: Submission.chart_divergence_density_formula
theorems.statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → ∃ w : Rn n → Rn n, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w V ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, Y (ψ x) = 0 → w x = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ w x).toLinearMap = Chapter02.areaJacobianAt ψ x * (tangentialDivergence M Y (ψ x) + inner ℝ (Y (ψ x)) (meanCurvature M (ψ x)))
